race.description: Racing On Melbourne Cup Day Hcp (C3)
race.comment: GUAC ON (1) returned to the winners' stall at Cairns last time out and winning hoop Kennedy sticks in the saddle. Will need to push forward from the outside draw and is sure to give backers a sight. UNIFIES (3) has placed three of four around this circuit and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble. Definite top-three prospects. The well-related SHE'S SPEEDY (7) (half to G3 winner Rich Fortune) has won two of three over this course and distance and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Worth including. SUPERVISE (2) is a former Victorian having his first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what he faced down south. Keep very safe. EXTRA FREE (10) is usually thereabouts and may earn some minor money again.
